classes.name: CatalogItem
classes.description: Represents a catalog item entity with properties like Name, Description, Price, PictureUri, and related type and brand IDs and objects. It provides methods to update its details, brand, type, and picture URI with validation.

classes.name: CatalogItemDetails
classes.description: A record struct used to encapsulate the details needed to update a CatalogItem, including Name, Description, and Price.

methods.name: get_Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the catalog item.

methods.name: get_Description
methods.description: Returns the description of the catalog item.

methods.name: get_Price
methods.description: Returns the price of the catalog item.

methods.name: get_PictureUri
methods.description: Returns the picture URI of the catalog item.

methods.name: get_CatalogTypeId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the catalog type.

methods.name: get_CatalogType
methods.description: Returns the catalog type object associated with the item.

methods.name: get_CatalogBrandId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the catalog brand.

methods.name: get_CatalogBrand
methods.description: Returns the catalog brand object associated with the item.

methods.name: .ctor(System.Int32,System.Int32,System.String,System.String,System.Decimal,System.String)
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a CatalogItem with type ID, brand ID, description, name, price, and picture URI.

methods.name: .ctor(System.String,System.String,System.Decimal)
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a CatalogItem with name, description, and price.

methods.name: UpdateDetails
methods.description: Updates the catalog item's Name, Description, and Price properties using the provided details object, with validation.

methods.name: UpdateBrand
methods.description: Updates the CatalogBrandId property after validating it's non-zero.

methods.name: UpdateType
methods.description: Updates the CatalogTypeId property after validating it's non-zero.

methods.name: UpdatePictureUri
methods.description: Updates the PictureUri property based on the provided picture name, forming a path string. Also handles empty or null string cases.
